en: Man
You lot have no business here! Get off our island and take your noisy bikes with you!
Paxton
Or what, old man? This island's ours now. You farmers can go and live somewhere else.
Hah? And who are you supposed to be? Another one who wants to tell us what to do?
Biker
Hey! You looking for trouble, kid?
Want to make something of it?
Big mistake! Let's see what you've got!
Biker
No way! Somebody else take this kid!
Biker
Boss! This kid's too tough for us!
Paxton
Pathetic, the lot of you. Fine, I'll deal with this one myself!
Paxton
Grr... All right, you win! This island's too boring for us anyway. Let's ride, boys!
Then get lost!
Man
Those bikers think they can push us around. Well, I won't be pushed!
You drove that whole gang off our island! Here, you've earned this.
Peace and quiet again. The whole island owes you, you know.
Man
There are so many of them... We can't drive them off on our own.
Lostelle from Two Island? Yes, I saw her go over Bond Bridge to the forest. Please, find her!
Biker
What are you staring at? Beat it, kid. This street's ours.
